register: Use Brazilian Portuguese, concise action labels and consistent você/seu when addressing the user; use Brazilian software terminology rather than European Portuguese. Keep JSTorrent, protocol identifiers, user-provided names, paths and placeholder syntax unchanged. Distinguish removing a torrent from deleting downloaded files, and keep app data separate from downloaded content. Use natural grammatical inflections and consistent terminology across React, native desktop and Android.

archive.meaning: Retains a paused torrent in Archived; not deletion.
archive.preferred: arquivar; arquivado; arquivando; Arquivados (seção da biblioteca)

checking.meaning: Hash verification in progress, distinct from checking for application updates.
checking.preferred: verificando; verificar novamente; verificando novamente; forçar nova verificação

completed.meaning: All selected data is verified. A completed torrent may still seed. Notifications should use a natural target-language download completion sentence.
completed.preferred: concluído; concluída; download concluído; O download de {name} foi concluído.

delete_data.meaning: Deletes the torrent's downloaded files after explicit confirmation; preserve the consequence.
delete_data.preferred: excluir dados baixados; excluir arquivos baixados; excluir arquivos; excluindo arquivos

done_button.meaning: A button dismissing or completing a dialog. Translate naturally in context; do not confuse the button with the transfer completion fact.
done_button.preferred: Concluir; Fechar (quando apenas fecha o diálogo)

download_folder.meaning: User-selected folder used to store downloads. Keep wording consistent across Android and the shared React UI.
download_folder.preferred: pasta de downloads; pastas de downloads

paused.meaning: Torrent is retained and ordinary transfer work is stopped.

remove.meaning: Removing a torrent preserves downloaded data unless deletion is explicitly selected. Never conflate this with deleting files.

restore.meaning: For archived torrents, return them from Archived. Distinguish file repair, settings reset and backup restoration when context differs.
restore.preferred: restaurar; restaurado; restaurando (torrent arquivado); restaurar acesso (à pasta); redefinir configurações; restaurar backup

resume.meaning: Resume a retained paused transfer. Distinguish resuming existing work from starting a new operation.

seeding.meaning: Uploading verified completed data, distinct from sharing a link. Distinguish the transfer state from the action.
seeding.preferred: distribuindo (estado); distribuir (ação); distribuição (atividade); distribuidor (par com conteúdo completo)

share_link.meaning: JSTorrent's share link, distinct from a magnet link.
share_link.preferred: link de compartilhamento; links de compartilhamento

share_ratio.meaning: Uploaded divided by downloaded bytes, not a percentage.

torrent.meaning: A transfer may download, seed, be paused or fetch metadata; do not replace every occurrence with Download.

tracker.meaning: A service introducing peers, not a data server.

verified.meaning: Distinguish verified data from the checking-in-progress state; inflect naturally.
verified.preferred: verificado; verificada; não verificado; não verificada; verificando (em andamento)

wifi_only.meaning: Preserve network-cost policy semantics. Do not promise all Wi-Fi is unmetered or free.
wifi_only.preferred: somente Wi-Fi; conexão com medição de dados; conexão sem medição de dados; pausar ao usar dados móveis ou Wi-Fi com medição de dados
